_authComment: Phase III Step 3a (DI-180f). authMode is DELIBERATELY ABSENT here, and absent/'pins' is the safe default (CONVENTIONS #10). THE HAZARD IS NOT ONBOARDING FRICTION. Setting "authMode": "supabase" on this build would derive isAdmin from a league_members row in a Supabase project ANY Google account can sign into and create a league in, and hand that derived commissioner flag to an app whose every write still lands in the live six-player league's Google Sheet (js/supabase-backend.js, Step 4, does not exist yet). A stranger would be commissioner of the real league. js/auth.js's hasSupabaseDataBackend() interlock now refuses that combination outright — banner, no session, and storage.save() throws — so this is defence in depth, not the only guard. Do not set authMode here until Step 4 has shipped AND Drew has approved cutover. supabaseUrl/supabaseAnonKey below are safe to ship regardless of authMode: the anon key is public-by-design (AD-05/AD-40 precedent for backendToken: inert without a user JWT, bounded by RLS) and is read but unused while authMode stays 'pins'.
